metadata.title: G1 Moves · captured StepTouch · 30 s

sourceWindow.description: One continuous original capture window; no concatenation, repetition, interpolation, or synthesized motion

metadata.timestampConvention: t=0 denotes first selected source sample; sourceIndex preserves the original CSV row
metadata.rootQuaternionSourceOrder: xyzw; normalized and exported as wxyz

detector.source: Heuristic from root-referenced FK sole height and minimum horizontal material-corner speed; no measured or simulated contact forces
detector.floorEstimate: 5th percentile of the minimum of both foot sole heights over the selected continuous window
detector.handoverRule: One-sample lookback at confirmed direct support transfers, with incoming height-on and speed-hold evidence; no extension across unsupported intervals
detector.endpointConvention: Support states [start,endExclusive); graph endpoints start and end=endExclusive-1 are supported samples
detector.limitation: A kinematic candidate-contact schedule, not force evidence. Both feet can slide or appear above the floor after retargeting. Threshold rejections may disconnect the graph; no motion edges fill those gaps. Recorded root is used only for labeling and held-out evaluation, never as a pose measurement in the solver.

licenseNotes.name: G1 Moves capture and retargeted motion
licenseNotes.creator: Mitch Chaiet / Experiential Technologies
licenseNotes.changes: Selected source rows 0..1799, converted quaternion order, computed local FK, and inferred candidate contact episodes; no frames repeated

licenseNotes.name: Unitree G1 model from MuJoCo Menagerie

frameSampling.rule: Keep contact starts and final supported samples; fill longer gaps with original samples at intervals of at most 1 seconds. Preserve the existing contact schedule.

model.name: Unitree G1 (29 actuated joints)
model.soleDefinition: Three fixed material points on a rectangular approximation of the capsule collision sole lower envelope, expressed in ankle-roll body coordinates; not changing collision centroids.

reference.description: Original retargeted motion root poses; held-out overlay/evaluation only after contact schedule annotation. No reference root pose is a graph input.

rigidity.description: Held-out ankle endpoint motion for each heuristic support episode; sliding/rocking violates stationary-patch assumptions
